description: This file defines an interface for wrapping external NetworkManager and libnm library functions within a C++ class. It primarily provides an abstract implementation class 'LibnmWrapsImpl' with virtual methods for various network-related operations and a singleton class 'LibnmWraps' that exposes static methods to access these functions. The purpose is likely to facilitate testing or abstraction of the network management functionalities.

classes.name: LibnmWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining virtual methods wrapping network management functionalities for testing or abstraction.

classes.name: LibnmWraps
classes.description: Singleton class providing static access to the wrapped network management functions.
